She brings multiple harnesses, models and tools into one agent that finishes real work in your projects and apps. Ready from day one, yours to shape over time. Cindy runs locally on your own machine, using your real files and logged in apps. The first supported harnesses are Claude Code and Codex — more are being added, and a native harness is in the works. Models and harnesses mix freely and can switch mid task while your workspace, memory, skills and tools stay continuous; one task can even be planned, executed in parallel, and reviewed by agents on different harness × model combos.
